mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements regarding the Andhra angle of the Government of India Act, 1935: 1. Provincial autonomy made an Andhra State look achievable. 2. The Sri Bagh Pact (November 1937) sought to close the Coastal-Rayalaseema rift. 3. The Sri Bagh Pact was concluded at the house of Tanguturi Prakasam. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq_fix.why: Sri Bagh Pact was 16 Nov 1937, after the Feb 1937 polls, not before

notes_fix.replace: Coastal-Rayalaseema rift addressed after the 1937 polls
notes_fix.why: Sri Bagh Pact signed 16 Nov 1937, after Feb 1937 elections

garbled: explanatory text merged into the stem

patterns: Quote attribution recurs: 'brakes but no engine' = Nehru on the 1935 Act.
Province-wise 1937 results: where Congress did not win a majority or form a ministry (Bengal, Punjab, Bombay traps).
Reason for the 1939 resignations (APPSC 2018): India made a party to the war with Germany without consultation.
Constitutional borrowings: residuary powers with the Governor-General; Instrument of Instructions became the DPSP.
App adds a strong Andhra layer (Madras ministry portfolios, Sri Bagh Pact) that PYQs do not test; the core PYQ facts are covered.
